summary_en: MFS Inc. will acquire up to 30.01 million yen of its own shares through an employee stock purchase program from February 15 to March 15, 2027, via SMBC Nikko Securities under a Rule 10b5-1 plan, to enhance employee motivation and asset formation.
title_en: Acquisition of Company Shares by Employees through Self-Share Purchase Program
translation_en_brief:
MFS Inc. announced on November 12, 2026, that it will implement an employee stock purchase program approved by the Board of Directors. Through this program, the company will acquire up to 30.01 million yen of its own shares during the period from February 15 to March 15, 2027. The acquisitions will be executed by SMBC Nikko Securities under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, with the purchase date falling within 20 business days following the next earnings announcement release.

The company determined to introduce this program in October 2024 to enhance employee motivation and facilitate wealth accumulation through share ownership. By enabling employees to build assets through holding company stock, management aims to strengthen employee engagement and long-term commitment to the organization. The company intends to continue operating this program on an ongoing basis, providing employees with regular opportunities to purchase company shares through structured mechanisms.
